scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable, 7 good with tangible friction, 10 exceptional across assessed use. Holistic subjective judgment of observed mobile emulation only, not derived from wins, terminal score or accuracy. Unassessed features receive no inferred enjoyment credit.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent atmospheric mission and effective touch assistance, with limited manual depth sampled and crowded small-screen information. Both wins demonstrate assisted completion only.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag worked in brief visible patrol engagements; tap aim provides a useful correction but also turns heading. Scene swipe worked. Full freehand tracking, evasion and uninterrupted bursts remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recover, coil timing and deck hold provide clear progression and phase variety. Much of these runs was assisted traversal with short combat samples; stationary rear-fire exposure was frustrating. Longer-term enjoyment cannot be inferred.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive rain-dark industrial setting, cyan/orange contrast, distinct coil visuals and polished terminal composition.
reasons.usability: Action label changes, route assistance, recovery progress, target confirmations, upload percentage and clear fresh restart reduce uncertainty. Competing threats and overlays still demand attention.
reasons.readability: Primary health, ammo and objective readable. Small compass, secondary instructions, Roman-numeral targets and distant patrol silhouettes require careful inspection; touch overlay covers lower scene.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed/functional with substantial friction, 7 good with clear limitations, 9 excellent, 10 exceptional. Subjective holistic ratings of observed emulated portrait interaction only; overall is not a win grade or arithmetic average.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent atmospheric mission with useful mobile guidance and clear progress feedback. Manual twin-contact combat worked, but aiming corrections, small targets, offscreen threat locating and uncertain phase timing kept it from feeling consistently effortless in these samples.
reasons.controls: MOVE and FIRE drag together and scene swipes visibly worked in both attempts, including patrol combat. Wider opening drag produced an armor-hit failure requiring retap. Assistance is substantial; continuous hold rearming and physical thumb comfort were not established.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, phased coils and uplink defense supply distinct visible tasks and readable success states. Route assists made traversal straightforward but sometimes reduced spatial understanding; two phase-window failures required waiting/correction. Unassessed tactics and memory reading not included in enjoyment judgment.
reasons.presentation: Strong rain-soaked industrial atmosphere, restrained teal/gold feedback, cohesive title and terminal layout. Some hard black bands/occluding structures and dark distant geometry reduce scene clarity.
reasons.usability: Large touch buttons, contextual approach label, understandable planning map and full terminal assist breakdown. Dense lower control cluster and occasional wall-facing assisted movement add friction; settings/tool flows not sampled.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and objective text legible at 390x844; coil labels and terminal stats clear. Small distant enemies and fine sign/map legend text take effort; dark geometry blends.
